technical.summary: Short-term overbought conditions with strong ADX trend but conflicting intermediate-term structure (price below 50-day MA, below cloud, negative CMF) create high pullback risk despite three white soldiers pattern.

fundamental.summary: DOC shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 32 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (25/100) with bearish AAII sentiment (47%) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absence of congressional buying and no news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (360.64), flat yield curve recession risk, rising dollar headwind, and negative macro score (-4) create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 32 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme market fear (VIX crisis, AAII bearish 47%) with contrarian buy signal and three white soldiers pattern offer asymmetric risk/reward if fear capitulates, supported by strong ADX trend confirmation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental collapse (zero insider/institutional conviction, earnings in 32 days), price trapped below both 50-day MA and Ichimoku cloud, RSI 82.6 overbought exhaustion, negative CMF, and macro crisis regime (VIX 360.64, flat yield curve, rising dollar) create multiple headwinds that overwhelm technical setup.
